title: 第13课 · 我是走回来的
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 13 — 我是走回来的 · I walked back

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在家 — At home

items.zh: 终于
items.py: zhōngyú
items.en: finally

items.zh: 爷爷
items.py: yéye
items.en: grandfather

items.zh: 礼物
items.py: lǐwù
items.en: gift, present

items.zh: 奶奶
items.py: nǎinai
items.en: grandmother

items.zh: 小丽：你终于回来了！从哪儿买回来这么多东西啊？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nǐ zhōngyú huílai le! Cóng nǎr mǎi huilai zhème duō dōngxi a?
items.en: Xiaoli: You're finally back! Where did you buy so many things?

items.zh: 小刚：都是从那边的商店买回来的。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Dōu shì cóng nà bian de shāngdiàn mǎi huilai de.
items.en: Xiaogang: I bought them all at the shop over there.

items.zh: 小丽：怎么还买红酒回来了？谁喝啊？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Zěnme hái mǎi hóngjiǔ huilai le? Shéi hē a?
items.en: Xiaoli: Why did you buy red wine too? Who's going to drink it?

items.zh: 小刚：这是给爷爷的礼物，明天我们一起送过去，看看爷爷奶奶。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Zhè shì gěi yéye de lǐwù, míngtiān wǒmen yīqǐ sòng guoqu, kànkan yéye nǎinai.
items.en: Xiaogang: It's a present for Grandpa. Tomorrow we'll take it over together and visit Grandpa and Grandma.

items.zh: 小丽：那我的礼物呢？快拿出来让我看看。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nà wǒ de lǐwù ne? Kuài ná chulai ràng wǒ kànkan.
items.en: Xiaoli: Then where's my present? Quick, take it out and let me see.

items.zh: 小刚：我不是已经回来了吗？
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Wǒ bù shì yǐjīng huílai le ma?
items.en: Xiaogang: Aren't I already back? (I'm your present!)

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在家 — At home

items.zh: 遇到
items.py: yùdào
items.en: to come across, to run into

items.zh: 一边
items.py: yìbiān
items.en: (doing two things) at the same time

items.zh: 过去
items.py: guòqù
items.en: past

items.zh: 小丽：我今天看见你和一个女的进了咖啡店，她是谁啊？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒ jīntiān kànjiàn nǐ hé yī ge nǚ de jìnle kāfēidiàn, tā shì shéi a?
items.en: Xiaoli: Today I saw you go into a café with a woman. Who is she?

items.zh: 小刚：她是我今天在路上遇到的一个老同学。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Tā shì wǒ jīntiān zài lùshang yùdào de yī ge lǎo tóngxué.
items.en: Xiaogang: She's an old classmate I ran into on the street today.

items.zh: 小丽：你们就一起去喝咖啡了？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nǐmen jiù yīqǐ qù hē kāfēi le?
items.en: Xiaoli: So you went for coffee together?

items.zh: 小刚：是啊，一边喝咖啡一边说了些过去的事。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Shì a, yībiān hē kāfēi yībiān shuōle xiē guòqù de shì.
items.en: Xiaogang: Yes, we talked about the old days while drinking coffee.

items.zh: 小丽：你回来得这么晚，是说了很多过去的事吗？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nǐ huílai de zhème wǎn, shì shuōle hěn duō guòqù de shì ma?
items.en: Xiaoli: You came back so late — was it because you talked a lot about the past?

items.zh: 小刚：不是。没有公共汽车了，我是走回来的。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Bù shì. Méiyǒu gōnggòng qìchē le, wǒ shì zǒu huilai de.
items.en: Xiaogang: No. There were no more buses, so I walked back.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在打电话 — On the phone

items.zh: 一般
items.py: yìbān
items.en: general, usual

items.zh: 愿意
items.py: yuànyì
items.en: would like to, to be willing

items.zh: 起来
items.py: qǐlai
items.en: to rise (upward movement)

items.zh: 应该
items.py: yīnggāi
items.en: should

items.zh: 生活
items.py: shēnghuó
items.en: life

items.zh: 同事：小丽，周末你一般跟小刚出去看电影吗？
items.py: Tóngshì: Xiǎolì, zhōumò nǐ yībān gēn Xiǎogāng chūqu kàn diànyǐng ma?
items.en: Colleague: Xiaoli, do you usually go out to the cinema with Xiaogang at the weekend?

items.zh: 小丽：我很少去电影院看电影，我更愿意在家看电视。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒ hěn shǎo qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn diànyǐng, wǒ gèng yuànyì zài jiā kàn diànshì.
items.en: Xiaoli: I rarely go to the cinema; I'd rather watch TV at home.

items.zh: 同事：看电视有什么意思啊？
items.py: Tóngshì: Kàn diànshì yǒu shénme yìsi a?
items.en: Colleague: What's so interesting about watching TV?

items.zh: 小丽：可以一边吃一边看，坐久了还可以站起来休息一会儿。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Kěyǐ yībiān chī yībiān kàn, zuò jiǔ le hái kěyǐ zhàn qilai xiūxi yīhuìr.
items.en: Xiaoli: You can eat while you watch, and when you've been sitting too long you can stand up and take a break.

items.zh: 同事：你应该多出去走走，这样你们的生活会更有意思。
items.py: Tóngshì: Nǐ yīnggāi duō chūqu zǒuzou, zhèyàng nǐmen de shēnghuó huì gèng yǒu yìsi.
items.en: Colleague: You should go out more; that way your life together would be more interesting.

items.zh: 小丽：有他在，我的生活已经很有意思了。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Yǒu tā zài, wǒ de shēnghuó yǐjīng hěn yǒu yìsi le.
items.en: Xiaoli: With him around, my life is already very interesting.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 短文 — My husband the headmaster

items.zh: 校长
items.py: xiàozhǎng
items.en: headmaster

items.zh: 坏
items.py: huài
items.en: broken, ruined

items.zh: 经常
items.py: jīngcháng
items.en: often

items.zh: 刚结婚的时候，我丈夫是中学老师，他喜欢每天早上起床后，一边吃早饭一边看报纸。
items.py: Gāng jié hūn de shíhou, wǒ zhàngfu shì zhōngxué lǎoshī, tā xǐhuan měi tiān zǎoshang qǐ chuáng hòu, yībiān chī zǎofàn yībiān kàn bàozhǐ.
items.en: When we had just got married, my husband was a middle school teacher. Every morning after getting up he liked to read the newspaper while eating breakfast.

items.zh: 十年过去了，现在他已经是校长了，因为太忙，每天早上我起床后都看不到他，晚上很晚他才回到家。
items.py: Shí nián guòqu le, xiànzài tā yǐjīng shì xiàozhǎng le, yīnwèi tài máng, měi tiān zǎoshang wǒ qǐ chuáng hòu dōu kàn bu dào tā, wǎnshang hěn wǎn tā cái huí dào jiā.
items.en: Ten years have passed and now he's a headmaster. Because he's so busy, I never see him after I get up in the morning, and he only gets home very late at night.

items.zh: 我真怕他累坏了。
items.py: Wǒ zhēn pà tā lèihuài le.
items.en: I'm really afraid he'll wear himself out.

items.zh: 希望他能少一些会议，多一些休息，可以经常和我还有孩子在一起。
items.py: Xīwàng tā néng shǎo yīxiē huìyì, duō yīxiē xiūxi, kěyǐ jīngcháng hé wǒ hái yǒu háizi zài yīqǐ.
items.en: I hope he can have fewer meetings and more rest, and often be together with me and our child.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (复合趋向补语 V + 回/出/进… + 来/去)

items.zh: 老师拿出一本书来。
items.py: Lǎoshī ná chu yī běn shū lai.
items.en: The teacher took out a book.

items.zh: 小狗从房间跑出来。
items.py: Xiǎogǒu cóng fángjiān pǎo chulai.
items.en: The puppy ran out of the room.

items.zh: 我给你拿过去吧。
items.py: Wǒ gěi nǐ ná guoqu ba.
items.en: Let me take it over to you.

items.zh: 坐久了还可以站起来休息一会儿。
items.py: Zuò jiǔ le hái kěyǐ zhàn qilai xiūxi yīhuìr.
items.en: When you've sat too long you can stand up and rest for a while.

items.zh: 老师走进教室来。
items.py: Lǎoshī zǒu jìn jiàoshì lai.
items.en: The teacher walked into the classroom.

items.zh: 弟弟跑下楼去。
items.py: Dìdi pǎo xià lóu qu.
items.en: My younger brother ran downstairs.

items.zh: 周太太走进咖啡店去。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai zǒu jìn kāfēidiàn qu.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou walked into the café.

items.zh: 下课了，同学们走出教室去。
items.py: Xià kè le, tóngxuémen zǒu chu jiàoshì qu.
items.en: Class is over and the students walk out of the classroom.

items.zh: 哥哥买回一个西瓜来。=哥哥买回来一个西瓜。
items.py: Gēge mǎi huí yī ge xīguā lai. = Gēge mǎi huilai yī ge xīguā.
items.en: My elder brother bought a watermelon and brought it back.

items.zh: 请大家拿出笔记本来。=请大家拿出来笔记本。
items.py: Qǐng dàjiā ná chu bǐjìběn lai. = Qǐng dàjiā ná chulai bǐjìběn.
items.en: Everyone, please take out your notebooks.

items.zh: 爸爸从国外带回一些礼物来。=爸爸从国外带回来一些礼物。
items.py: Bàba cóng guówài dài huí yīxiē lǐwù lai. = Bàba cóng guówài dài huilai yīxiē lǐwù.
items.en: Dad brought back some presents from abroad.

items.zh: 小刚买回来很多东西。=小刚买回很多东西来。
items.py: Xiǎogāng mǎi huilai hěn duō dōngxi. = Xiǎogāng mǎi huí hěn duō dōngxi lai.
items.en: Xiaogang bought a lot of things and brought them back.

items.zh: 哥哥买回来了一个西瓜。
items.py: Gēge mǎi huilai le yī ge xīguā.
items.en: My elder brother has bought a watermelon (completed action: object after 来).

items.zh: 爸爸带回来了一些礼物。
items.py: Bàba dài huilai le yīxiē lǐwù.
items.en: Dad has brought some gifts home.

items.zh: 妈妈一边唱歌一边做饭。
items.py: Māma yībiān chàng gē yībiān zuò fàn.
items.en: Mum sings while she cooks.

items.zh: 老师边说边笑。
items.py: Lǎoshī biān shuō biān xiào.
items.en: The teacher laughed as she talked.

items.zh: 小丽和老同学边喝咖啡边聊天儿。
items.py: Xiǎolì hé lǎo tóngxué biān hē kāfēi biān liáo tiānr.
items.en: Xiaoli chatted with her old classmate while drinking coffee.

items.zh: 我丈夫喜欢一边吃早饭一边看报纸。
items.py: Wǒ zhàngfu xǐhuan yībiān chī zǎofàn yībiān kàn bàozhǐ.
items.en: My husband likes to read the newspaper while eating breakfast.
